unit: source asset paired across two isolated fresh model contexts
report_scope: public reproducible development-set pilot; no sealed-test or sim-to-real claim
same_in_both: task specification and declared acceptance tolerances
treatment: repository Content Agents workflow prompts, orchestration, artifact and validation contracts
control: direct Astra authoring with same low-level tools; no Content Agents workflow instructions or coordinator
metrics: false passes: agent claimed accepted but independent evaluator rejects
human interventions and timed review where observable
cost per accepted asset with explicit rate provenance or unknown
cost_policy: Never equate subscription with zero marginal dollar cost. Missing model or Horde rates remain unknown; retain usage and a rate calculator. Zero accepted assets means undefined per-accepted cost.
hardware: 4 full48GB L40 GPUs across two Horde DGXC nodes, matched host and GPU per paired asset
codex_runtime: 0.154.0 for both arms; dependency compatibility override from pinned repository0.147.0
indeterminate_policy: Evaluator insufficient, backend unavailable, or missing independent ground truth is INCONCLUSIVE, never a demonstrated false pass. Report measured subset and full-denominator lower bounds separately.
repair_limit_enforcement: Declared2repair policy, audit output chronology; wall-time hard-enforced by process-group watchdog. Violations invalidate pair.
independent_human_review: No human intervention during arms; unmeasured later review minutes remain null. Root/curation/evaluator preparation is automated setup, reported separately.
case_freeze_policy: Each independent evaluator and task contract freezes before its first scored run. Evaluator authors remain blind to scored outputs. Shared thresholds cannot change after a scored run starts; any discovered evaluator defect is reported and versioned separately.
budget_definition: Equal2400-second hard wall-time cap and declared two repairs. No token cap; model usage is measured as an outcome.
